prompts.scout: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production Factorio technology icon on a genuinely transparent background, square composition, no text, no frame, no ground. Subject: a compact THREE-LEGGED logistics/scout Spidertron, faithful to the supplied vanilla Spidertron's orange brass rounded body, red sensor eye, dark segmented jointed legs and worn industrial finish. It has EXACTLY THREE legs total, spaced radially at 120 degrees with every leg separately visible: one to the left, one to the right, one toward the viewer. No extra limbs, no gun barrels, no weapon turrets, no rockets. Small cargo housing and a modest sensor head integrated into the central round body, no bulky additions. Elevated three-quarter Factorio view, upper-left key light, crisp metal highlights, substantial readable shapes, muted brass/steel and one small red sensor. Subject fills about 84 percent of a square with clear transparent margins. Clean game asset, rich mechanical detail but readable at 32 pixels. The supplied image is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only, not a leg-count reference. Produce only the single largest icon; no mipmap copies, no side thumbnails, no checkerboard drawn into pixels.
